row.body: The clinic key is attached to a note saying one patient did not become ill; the return sheet lists the helper as absent.
row.title: The helper was not on the list

cites.quote: Jolene didn't get sick. She can help.

sidecar.gloss: A clinic note and an absent helper leave a care handoff incomplete.
sidecar.rival_reading: A field trial might record an unaffected worker and a clinic visit; the absent helper does not show a failed evacuation.
